camera_frame_width.title: Camera frame width (px)
camera_frame_width.description: Pixel width the detection bounding boxes are expressed in. Used to convert a target's image position into an angular aim error. Set to the vision pipeline's capture resolution.

camera_frame_height.title: Camera frame height (px)
camera_frame_height.description: Pixel height the detection bounding boxes are expressed in. Set to the vision pipeline's capture resolution.

camera_hfov_deg.title: Camera horizontal FOV (deg)
camera_hfov_deg.description: Horizontal field of view of the aiming camera, in degrees. Maps a horizontal pixel offset to a yaw error for the aim loop.

camera_vfov_deg.title: Camera vertical FOV (deg)
camera_vfov_deg.description: Vertical field of view of the aiming camera, in degrees. Maps a vertical pixel offset to a pitch error for the aim loop.

aim_gain.title: Aim gain
aim_gain.description: Fraction of the angular error the gimbal moves each detection update. Lower is slower and more stable; higher is faster but risks overshoot. The default is deliberately conservative.

aim_deadband_frac.title: Aim dead-band (fraction of half-frame)
aim_deadband_frac.description: A centred target within this normalized offset produces no command, so a well-centred target does not jitter the gimbal. Expressed as a fraction of the half-frame (0 = no dead-band).

aim_invert_pitch.title: Invert aim pitch
aim_invert_pitch.description: Flip if the gimbal slews the wrong way on the bench in pitch. The pitch sign convention is unvalidated against hardware; this corrects a reversed pitch axis with no code change.

aim_invert_yaw.title: Invert aim yaw
aim_invert_yaw.description: Flip if the gimbal slews the wrong way on the bench in yaw. The yaw sign convention is unvalidated against hardware; this corrects a reversed yaw axis with no code change.

designate_camera.title: Aim camera id
designate_camera.description: Camera id whose detection stream drives the aim loop. Leave empty to consume every camera's detections.

aim.title: Aim at target active
aim.description: Arms the aim-at-target loop. Flipped on when the operator picks 'Aim at this target' on a designated detection, and off to stop. While active, the gimbal tracks the vision engine's locked target and holds its angle whenever the lock is uncertain or lost.
